name: memory_superposition_query
description: Fast associative recall through continuous wave interference in < 1 ms. Discovers resonant attractor basins in the Kerr phase-space manifold and checks bistable hysteretic latch states.

query.description: Contextual cue, problem statement, or concept prompt (e.g. 'breaking time reversal symmetry in 3D vortices').

top_k.description: Maximum number of resonant memory attractors to return (default 5).

min_resonance.description: Minimum wave interference resonance amplitude (0.0 to 1.0, default 0.20).
